test_execution.environment: apps/spa/vitest.config.ts; JSDOM; no globalSetup; setup file only registers Vue Test Utils stubs. Parent-page service imports are mocked; no database or provider access observed.
test_execution.observed_output: Vitest printed repeated JSDOM “Not implemented: navigation to another Document” notices while page tests exercised the production anchor-click download path. This is a browser-download limitation of JSDOM; tests passed, but actual download/navigation behavior was not verified in a browser.

architecture_observations: ReportWorkbenchPage remains the state owner: URL-backed filters, server-owned report data/execution state, and local loading/error/export state are passed to extracted children as props; children emit intent events.
The page assigns request sequence numbers and ignores stale responses, but does not abort superseded requests; a stale server-side execution may still complete even when its response is not rendered.
Pending export recovery and its stable execution-scoped idempotency key live in page memory; the path does not demonstrate restoration after a full reload.
ReportFilterPanel accepts independent is-report booleans and one broad filter object, so invalid combinations remain representable at the component boundary; current page wiring supplies the flags.

Native details/summary disclosures are used. The recovery panel has role=status/aria-live with interactive actions; automated component tests do not establish assistive-technology behavior or focus handling.
Responsive grid/flex rules are present in extracted components, but no browser screenshot, viewport matrix, keyboard, or screen-reader test was run.

candidate_actions.hold_reason: The seven small child components and tests are reviewed and hash-stable. The parent page and its 3,044-line test were exercised but not fully reviewed for candidate inclusion; browser download, responsive, accessibility, and visual behavior remain unverified, and no independent critique has approved this group.

limitations: The seven extracted source paths and seven corresponding tests are the only paths added to the original content-review denominator in this round; ReportWorkbenchPage.vue and ReportWorkbenchPage.test.ts remain pending content review.

Component tests establish only the exercised JSDOM props/render/events and mocked page-service flows; they do not establish browser, visual, responsive, keyboard, screen-reader, or production network behavior.
JSDOM navigation notices arise from anchor.click in the browser download helper. The tests passed but the actual file download behavior was not exercised.
All source paths remain excluded from a candidate overlay pending the parent-page review, browser revalidation, complete provenance/sensitivity review, and independent critique.
